Dance

YMCA dance programs provide a welcoming, inclusive space where every child can explore movement, express their creativity, and grow in confidence. Through dance, children develop coordination and new skills while building connections, celebrating individuality, and experiencing the joy of being part of a community where everyone belongs.

Classes will be held at the Clarksville Branch.


Movement Adventurers: 6-weeks (Ages 3-5)

Clarksville
11/11/26 - 12/16/26
VIEW

Designed for ages 3–5, this playful, story-based 6-week dance class invites tiny dancers to use their imaginations as they explore movement, discover what their bodies can do, and learn to move through space in different ways. Through music, storytelling, and creative play, children build coordination, confidence, and a love of movement in a fun, welcoming environment where every child belongs.

Sessions will be held on Wednesdays from 4:45-5:30PM at the Clarksville Branch.
